clarifications.statement: W2a's arithmetic mean of force samples taken every 4 solver steps is accepted only for the registered nearly-steady Re=100 capability fixture; it is a steady-fixture diagnostic, not the canonical time average.

Future canonical time-averaged aerodynamic responses must use physical solver time weighting, mean(F) = integral(F dt) / integral(dt), implemented with a registered trapezoidal or equivalent time-weighted rule over the measurement window.

The WaterLily backend returns the Cartesian body-force vector F_body = (Fx, Fy, Fz) = -total_force(sim). drag, lift and downforce are not fixed component numbers in the generic backend; they are projections onto registered ProblemSpec / physical-profile directions.
